---
title: Cuttlefish Risotto
id: MAR-0104
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g cuttlefish
- 280 g rice
- 1 tablespoon parsley
- 2 garlic cloves
- 9 dl fish stock
- 1 dl white wine
- 10 g butter
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
## Method
1. Cut the cuttlefish into thick strips.
2. Heat the extra virgin olive oil in a pan, add the peeled garlic, let it wilt for 4 minutes and remove it.
3. Add the cuttlefish and let them flavor for 3-4 minutes; raise the heat, pour in the white wine and let it boil, then adjust the heat and cook for 40 minutes.
4. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for a minute.
5. Pour the fish stock one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
6. Add the cuttlefish and parsley, mix and serve.
